description: Prepares a testimonial request from the customer's name, company, success story and the type of testimonial you want. Optional role, relationship, intended use, incentive, your product and business model fit it to the customer. Returns a request email, interview questions for the customer's role and sector, quote drafts for the customer to edit and a sign-off checklist. It uses your product name when you give it and says so when you do not.

business_model.description: Optional: how you charge, so the advice fits it. If omitted, it is read from your text and the answer says how.

incentive.description: Optional: what you are offering in return

relationship_context.description: How long they have been a customer and the key interactions

success_story.description: A short description of their success with your product

testimonial_type.description: The kind of testimonial you need

use_case.description: Where the testimonial will be used (the website or a sales deck, for example)

your_product.description: Optional: your product or service name, used in the answer. Without it the answer says so and shows a placeholder.

your_sector.description: Optional: your company's own industry (not your customers'). When given, it decides the sector notes; when left out, the tool reads it from your words and stays neutral if they are unclear.

name: testimonial_capture
title: Testimonial Capture
